title: genomic_pathology_extraction
description: Schema v4 — aligns to the mCODE genomic_pathology_extraction v2 production prompt. Changes vs v3: (a) Genomic_Variant_umbrella is RE-INTRODUCED as a separate top-level section (un-merges the v3 'variant_detail nested in biomarker' design); (b) other_molecular_biomarker_umbrella is FLATTENED to one record per biomarker {page_number, biomarker_name, method, result, reference_range, interpretation} — no findings[]/occurrences[]/variant_detail/biomarker_class; (c) significant_findings + clinical_information are kept (v3 shapes) but are OPTIONAL — disabled by default via the per-team `enabled` flag in config/teams.yaml (D3), revivable without schema change; (d) report_metadata keeps the 5 internal-only extra fields (D4) which to_production drops. Output is wrapped under the top key 'genomic_pathology_extraction'. Field-level VERBATIM vs DERIVED semantics live in 'extraction_mode'; multi-fragment concatenations use the ' | ' (space-pipe-space) separator; missing = JSON null. Consumed by core/schema_loader.py which does NOT resolve $ref — every shape is inlined on purpose.

count_of_extracted_objects.description: Number of top-level umbrella sections containing at least one extracted item (report_metadata always counts as 1; +1 per umbrella with count > 0).

provenance.description: Per-field provenance. PREFERRED an ARRAY of [{field_name, block_id, page, type ('verbatim'|'inferred'|'derived'|'absent'), rationale}] — one entry per emitted field. (Legacy field_name->entry map also accepted.) Powers the UI block explorer + the SME trace's per-field reasoning.

total_pages.description: Number of pages in the source PDF (from page count, not report text).

report_title.description: Report title / header banner literally as printed.

llm_confidence_score.description: Model self-reported confidence for this section, 0.0-1.0.

Patient_MRN.description: Patient Medical Record Number. STRICT: only when the source label is literally 'MRN', 'Medical Record #', or 'Med Rec #'. NOT Accession Number, Case Number, ID #, 'Your No', or Specimen ID.

Patient_DOB.description: Date of birth, in the exact format shown in the report.

Vendor_Name.description: Lab vendor that generated the report (NeoGenomics, Tempus, Foundation Medicine, Caris, ...). May be inferred from product markers when not explicitly named.

Collection_Date.description: Specimen collection date, in the exact format shown.

Received_Date.description: Date the specimen was received by the vendor/lab.

Report_Date.description: Date the report was generated / finalized.

Procedure.description: Procedure / method used for the test.

Practice_Name.description: Ordering practice / clinic name. NOT the testing lab vendor.

Practice_State.description: State where the practice is located.

Practice_ZIP_4digit.description: ZIP+4 suffix when present, else null.

Report_Type.description: INTERNAL-ONLY extra (D4; not in target schema). Report type/category as printed; to_production drops it.

Accession_Number.description: INTERNAL-ONLY extra (D4). Accession / Case Number as printed. NOT the MRN. to_production drops it.

Signing_Pathologist.description: INTERNAL-ONLY extra (D4). Signing / reviewing pathologist. to_production drops it.

Ordering_Provider_Phone.description: INTERNAL-ONLY extra (D4). Ordering provider's direct phone if distinct from the practice phone. to_production drops it.

Additional_Provider_Name.description: INTERNAL-ONLY extra (D4). A second/treating/copy-to provider. to_production drops it.

Genomic_Variant_umbrella.description: Genomic_Variant represents a set of changes in the tested sample compared to a reference sequence for a genome (mCODE genomic-variant profile). One object per distinct variant. RE-INTRODUCED in v4 as a separate top-level section (v3 had merged these into biomarker findings.variant_detail). Every field is emitted on every variant object; null when not on the page (never omitted).

count_of_Genomic_Variants.description: Total count of Genomic Variants extracted; MUST equal Genomic_Variants length.

provenance.description: Per-field provenance — PREFERRED an ARRAY of [{field_name, block_id, page, type, rationale}] (legacy map also accepted). One entry per emitted field in THIS variant. Powers the SME trace's per-field reasoning + the explorer.

page_number.description: Page in the report where the variant information is found. Use the printed page number if available, else estimate from document position.

gene_studied.description: The gene examined in the study (HGNC-preferred where resolvable; call hgnc_normalize).

method.description: The mechanism used to perform the observation (e.g. NGS, PCR, FISH, Sanger sequencing).

result.description: The variant call status. VERBATIM when the report prints a literal Detected/Not Detected/Positive/Negative; INFERRED='Detected' when the variant is listed in a found-variants table; INFERRED='Not Detected' when the report explicitly says it was sought and absent. Else null. Pathogenicity wording (Pathogenic / VUS / etc.) belongs in `clinical_significance`, not here.

variant_allele_frequency.description: Fraction of reads identifying the variant allele, typically a percentage (e.g. '20.3%'). String to preserve units.

dna_change_type.description: Codified type for the associated DNA marker. Open vocab — accepted values include but are not limited to: Wild type, Deletion, Duplication, Insertion, Deletion/Insertion, Inversion, Substitution.

amino_acid_change_type.description: Codified type for the associated amino-acid marker. Open vocab — accepted values include but are not limited to: Wild type, Deletion, Duplication, Frameshift, Initiating Methionine, ...

genomic_dna_change.description: Genomic DNA change reported in 'g.' format (e.g. 'g.140753336T>A'). VERBATIM as printed.

genomic_reference_sequence.description: NCBI genomic nucleotide RefSeq ID or LRG identifier (e.g. 'NC_000007.14').

coding_dna_change.description: Coding DNA change reported in 'c.' format (e.g. 'c.1799T>A'). VERBATIM as printed (even without the 'c.').

transcript_reference_sequence.description: Transcript reference sequence ID (e.g. 'NM_004333.4', 'LRG_...t1'). PRESERVE the version integer.

amino_acid_change.description: Amino-acid change reported in 'p.' format (e.g. 'p.V600E'). VERBATIM as printed (even without the 'p.').

amino_acid_reference_sequence.description: Reference sequence of the amino-acid change (e.g. 'NP_004324.2').

clinical_significance.description: Interpretation of the variant. Extract the exact wording (e.g. 'PATHOGENIC', 'Variant of Unknown Significance', 'LIKELY BENIGN').

genomic_source_class.description: Genomic source class as printed (Somatic, Germline, Likely Somatic).

genomic_position.description: Genomic position of the variant (e.g. '140453136'). String to preserve formatting.

exon.description: Exon number in which the variant is located, if reported.

needs_review.description: INTERNAL. Escalation flag — true when this record relied on an inference that changed a literal token (OCR context-correction, low-margin synonym match) or an unresolved ambiguity.

review_reason.description: INTERNAL. Why needs_review is set; null when not flagged.

hgvs_normalized.description: INTERNAL. The HGVS-canonical forms (with c./p./g. prefixes, version-aware) from hgvs_validate — SEPARATE from the verbatim fields so the printed surface is preserved AND the normalized form is available. to_production drops it.

other_molecular_biomarker_umbrella.description: Molecular biomarkers which do NOT fit the definition of a Genomic_Variant. DO include: protein expression by IHC (ER, PR, HER2, MMR, PD-L1, Ki-67, CK5, p40, CD-markers); genomic-instability signatures (TMB, MSI, LOH, HRD, ctDNA Tumor Fraction). DO NOT include: histological findings (nuclear grade, growth pattern, necrosis) or general lab markers (Hb, hCG, glucose, iron, reticulin, RhD). FLAT in v4 — one record per biomarker (no findings[]/occurrences[]/variant_detail/biomarker_class).

count_of_other_molecular_biomarkers.description: Total count of other_molecular_biomarkers; MUST equal the list length.

provenance.description: Per-field provenance — PREFERRED an ARRAY of [{field_name, block_id, page, type, rationale}] (legacy map also accepted). One entry per emitted field in THIS biomarker record.

page_number.description: Page where the biomarker information is found.

biomarker_name.description: The name of the biomarker as stated in the report.

method.description: The method used to test the biomarker (e.g. IHC, NGS, FISH, Special Stains).

result.description: The result of the biomarker test, verbatim.

genotype.description: Specific alleles (e.g. "A*30:02, A*02:01"). ONLY for HLA and PGx rows.

reference_range.description: The reference range of the result value, if provided.

review_reason.description: INTERNAL. Why needs_review is set; null when not flagged.

tested_biomarker_umbrella.description: Every single unique biomarker that was tested, analyzed, or evaluated in the report, regardless of whether findings are positive, negative, indeterminate, or not detected. Sources: named gene panels; gene lists/tables; findings-based names (anything appearing in Genomic_Variant or other_molecular_biomarker); IHC protein markers; genomic-instability markers. EXCLUDE non-molecular stains (PAS, Giemsa, iron, reticulin, H&E) and enzyme stains (lysozyme). Output ALPHABETIZED + UNIQUE.

count_of_tested_biomarkers.description: Total count of tested biomarkers; MUST equal tested_biomarkers length.

page_numbers.description: Pages where tested biomarkers are found.

tested_biomarkers.description: Alphabetized, deduplicated list of unique biomarker / gene names. Do NOT list test METHODS (NGS, MSI, FISH, IHC) as biomarker names.

significant_findings.description: OPTIONAL in v4 — DISABLED by default (D3: specimen_findings_team enabled:false in config/teams.yaml). Present only when the team is re-enabled. Multi-specimen pathology narrative; one specimen_findings[] entry per specimen. Shape carried unchanged from v3.

specimen.description: Specimen identity rows. One per labelled specimen (A, B, ...).

clinical_information.description: OPTIONAL in v4 — DISABLED by default (D3: clinical_info_team enabled:false in config/teams.yaml). Present only when the team is re-enabled. Clinical history + reason for study. Shape carried unchanged from v3.
